problems_fixed.what: Broken problem: y=x+1, y=x^2-x-1 had irrational roots (1±√3) but stored a wrong integer answer 2 and the misconception admitted it. Replaced curve with x^2-2x-3 so roots are clean.
Broken problem: y=x+5, y=x^2+3x+1 gave irrational roots (-1±√5); stored answer 0 was self-contradictory. Changed curve constant to +2 so it factorises.
Reframed from single-value derived questions (larger x / y-value / intersection count) to the two-x-values format; verified roots.
Degenerate problem: y=3-x, x^2+xy=4 cancels x^2 (gives linear 3x=4, one root). Reposed with slope-2 line so x^2 survives.
Broken problem: y=x+1, y=x^2-3x+5 gives a repeated root (x-2)^2=0 (one solution); stored answer 4 was inconsistent. Changed curve constant to +1 for two distinct roots.
Reframed circle/xy problems to two-x-values; verified both pairs satisfy both equations.
Messy problem: 2x+y=7, x^2-xy=6 gives x=3 and x=-2/3 (x^2-xy with a linear line always forces leading coeff >=2 and a fractional root). Replaced with a clean circle.
Tangency 'value of k' problem has only one (repeated) x, cannot be a two-x-values item. Replaced with a clean leading-coefficient quadratic.
